subject: [RFC PATCH 5/6] mm/filemap: plumb alloc_flags through folio allocation

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch adds an internal filemap folio allocator that accepts and preserves explicit allocator behavior flags (alloc_flags) across allocation paths in the mm/filemap module. The existing filemap_alloc_folio_noprof function is modified to accept alloc_flags, allowing MM-internal callers to preserve these flags. This change does not introduce any functional changes but provides a way for internal callers to control allocator behavior. The patch includes modifications to several functions within the mm/filemap.c file and introduces new inline functions to handle allocation with specific flags.
